title: NYRR Marathon Time Qualifiers — 2027 TCS New York City Marathon standards
claims: The standards apply to non-complimentary guaranteed entry to the 2027 TCS New York City Marathon; the qualifying window runs January 1 through December 31, 2026, and net (chip) time, not gun time, is evaluated.
Age for the standards is the runner's age on November 7, 2027.

NYRR Time Qualifiers: meeting the standard at an in-person NYRR marathon or half marathon within the window earns non-complimentary guaranteed entry; eligible NYRR races are the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half, 2026 Maybelline Women's Half, 2026 RBC Brooklyn Half, 2026 Staten Island Half and 2026 TCS New York City Marathon.

Non-NYRR Time Qualifiers: only a certified full marathon outside NYRR counts; half-marathon times are not eligible; submission of a qualifying time does not guarantee entry, and if applications exceed spots entry goes to the fastest in each age and gender category, with the rest moved to the non-guaranteed general drawing.

Non-NYRR qualifying courses must be certified by USATF, AIMS, World Athletics or the national distance-running governing body of the host country; indoor marathons, virtual marathons, triathlons, other distances, and personal Strava or GPS times are not accepted; the time must be verifiable on the race results page.
Half-marathon times are accepted only from an NYRR half marathon; the Non-NYRR Time Qualifier entry is accepted on full marathon times only.

The Local Competitive Program places qualified club-affiliated runners in Wave 1, Pink Corral A, with a heated start tent, private portable toilets and streamlined corral entry; club captains submitted runners August 3 to September 2, 2026, and notifications went out by September 8, 2026.
